subject: infra.cybersec
name: National Cybersecurity Strategy
what_would_settle_it: The text of the strategy the minister invoked at the LesComCSIRT launch, or an official statement of its adoption date, version and targets. The 2022 Cybersecurity Capacity Maturity Model review states Lesotho had no official national strategy.
disposition: partly found - the ITU records supporting development of a national cybersecurity strategy from June 2024, and the LCA publishes a Cyber Security page said to carry national strategies; no strategy text located. The 2022 Cybersecurity Capacity Maturity Model review (cybilportal.org) confirming Lesotho had no official NCS, and the Computer Crime and Cyber Security Bill 2024 on the National Assembly site, are raised as acquisition lines. The absence of the strategy itself stands, dated.

subject: data.open
name: National open data portal
what_would_settle_it: A government open-data portal or published open-data policy for Lesotho, or an official statement that none exists.
disposition: partly found - no government open-data portal exists. A Lesotho Data Portal is hosted on the opendataforafrica platform, and a 2022 MCC-commissioned data-use assessment records a civil-society Lesotho Open Data Initiative from 2019, no access-to-information legislation, and Lesotho ranked 151 of 187 on the Open Data Inventory (2020). Raised as an acquisition line; the government absence stands.
